title: Nixie: Efficient, Transparent Temporal Multiplexing for Consumer GPUs
note: Best-matched paper in the venue for this machine: a *user-space system service* that time-multiplexes several near-GPU-memory-filling ML jobs on a **consumer GPU** with "no application or driver changes", plus an MLFQ-style scheduler. Eval repo: https://github.com/XOR-op/nixie-eval . Concern: pinned-host-memory pressure experiments assume a large host RAM budget (we have it)
